About this item

  • Wider Coverage : The Bulb comes with 220 Degree Light Coverage, which makes the home brighter
  • Wattage : 9W Colour : Warm White (2700K) Base : B22 Number of Units : 1
  • Wide Voltage Range & High Voltage Protection: This LED Bulb has a wide voltage range of 150-300VAC & High Voltage protection upto 400 VAC, Surge Protection upto 4 kV, protecting the device from fluctuations for long lasting performance
  • Energy Efficient: These LED Bulbs are more efficient than conventional lights, saving upto 50% energy & electricity bills.
  • Long Life: Wipro LED Bulb comes with high quality LM 80 Tested LED that ensures long life.
  • Durable & Long-Lasting Lights that are a perfect choice for your living room, corridor, bedroom, kitchen and for display in shops for eye soothing light to calm your mood
  • B22 Bulb Base : It comes with B22D Bulb base and usable with any regular sockets wich use a pair of pins on the outside of the base that slide into slots in the socket.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers say

    Customers find these LED bulbs to be of good quality and appreciate their brightness, with one customer noting they provide sufficient illumination. The color receives mixed feedback, with some customers liking the warm white light while others complain about a yellowish tint. Additionally, opinions on value for money are divided between those who consider it a steal and those who find it overpriced.

    • Satish Yadav
      1 out of 5 stars
      Does not last as much as Wipro claims
      Reviewed in India on 20 November 2021
      Colour: Warm WhiteSize: Pack of 2Style Name: 9W B22
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Wipro claims that its LED bulbs last for 1000's of hours of use (can't remember the exact figure). But that is nonsense. These bulbs only last 1 or 1.5 years or maximum 2 years of daily use of about 3 hours. This does not work out to the 1000's of hours of use they claim. I think it is more economical to buy the ordinary incandescent bulbs which cost Rs 15 at my local shop. In 1.5 years I will only have to use at most 3 bulbs which works out to Rs 60 compared to LED bulbs costing anywhere from 130 to 300 per bulb. The savings on electricity I believe are negligible. The LED bulbs would have been worth it if it was easy to remove the bulb base and repair the circuit when it stops working. But thats not easy so we have to throw it away and buy a new one which makes this very uneconomical in my view. Its not just Wipro, all manufacturers of LED bulbs give you a rubbish story about how long these bulbs last. All of them are deliberately misleading and cheating customers. Sometimes the bulbs last only a month or so and the return time frame has passed so customer has been cheated. Don't believe the warranty - on Amazon it is extremely difficult to get any vendor or manufacturer to honour the warranty. (even for other products). The kirana shopkeeper is more honest. He will replace the bulb upto period of one year.
